correctness.rationale: The two exponential factors have positive-definite undamped product and half-trace S=c²cosh(pT)+(1-c²)cosh(pΔ), determinant one; the Floquet multiplier radius is exp(-aT+arcosh S). Thus stability is equivalent to S<cosh(aT). At balanced dwell the ratio sinh(aT/2)/sinh(pT/2) is strictly decreasing, giving one cutoff iff 0<c<a/p, with c=0 all-period exception and c>=a/p impossibility. The fixed-duty deficit has even Taylor coefficients p^{2k}[c²+(1-c²)m^{2k}]-a^{2k}; monotonicity of weighted power means makes their signs change only from negative to positive, so F(T)/T^{2K} increases through exactly one zero when the average is Hurwitz. The stated exact Δ*, strict fractional shrinkage, logarithmic c->0 and sqrt(T*-T) limits follow from these identities; c=1 gives no stability. A direct independent 2x2 eigenspectrum/expm check agreed in three nontrivial parameter sets; finite checks are not the proof.
